name: @kickside/ui-ui
title: KickSide Appearance
description: Navigation appearance editor web component for kickside/ui — edits layout, categories, and per-surface overrides.

wippy.description: Navigation appearance editor web component (kickside-appearance), rendered as the Appearance settings tab (ui.settings_tab) by tag. It edits the nav layout (vertical/horizontal), renames, re-icons, reorders, hides and re-categorizes the surfaces and categories modules declare (loaded from GET /api/v1/nav/list?manage=1), and manages branding — site title, logo upload via POST /api/v1/nav/logo, primary color tone and the home surface — persisting everything as kickside.ui settings through PUT /api/v1/nav/config, which broadcasts so open UIs update in realtime on save. It takes no props and emits no custom events; it owns its own Save/Discard toolbar (the host System page owns the header and tab strip) and uses the Wippy host's authenticated HTTP client (the @wippy-fe/proxy api).
